verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an in-dashboard AI Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Supabase in the MCP server role: it offers its own hosted MCP server for external agents and lets developers host their own MCP servers on Edge Functions. Nothing shows Supabase or its AI Assistant connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
